entities.title: The JSON layer's result envelope
entities.summary: Every JSON-layer operation and validator returns a UtvResult, this library's form of the utv-result/1.0 envelope; the typed layer's Outcome.toResult builds the same shape.
consumers: Application developers who call the JSON layer (builders, parseIso, add, resolve, validateStructural, …)
The typed layer in values.ts, which turns each result into an Outcome
test/everyday.test.ts and test/text-form.test.ts, which compare results with the shared fixtures
guarantees: schema is "utv-result/1.0"; operation is "validate" for validation, otherwise the operation's name (parseIso, add, resolve, parseText, fromDate, …).
status is one of invalid, unsupported, indeterminate, none, unique, multiple, range, symbolic, resource-limit, error, valid.
unique has exactly one candidate, multiple all of them in ascending order, every other status none.
Diagnostics are {code, severity, path, message}, with path a JSON pointer into the arguments (/0, /1, …) or the value.
resolve and toZone with a named zone, and fromDate with a zone, list the rule bundle's ruleSet in manifest.dependencies.
assumptions is always empty; loss is lossless except where a native conversion reports what it lost.
A semantic outcome is never thrown; an unexpected exception inside an operation becomes status error with code internal-error.
entities.compatibility: Follows spec/RESULT-CONTRACT.md, versioned with the specification. The operation names extend the contract's list (docs/everyday-api.md, Clarifications 5; OI-17).
